items.text: Fixtures, tooling, work holding, and soft jaws
This makes Kevlar reinforced filaments perfect for 3D printing durable parts that will not break easily.
Protective gear
No enclosure, or heated chamber needed.
Easy to print on open desktop 3D printers
Kevlar does not break and by that greatly improves the impact and damage resistance.
ApolloX Kevlar is very easy to 3D print on open desktop machines.
High damage, impact, and fatigue resistance
Very high strength-to-weight ratio
Reducing shrinkage / warping
Increasing dimensional stability
Masking layer lines with a matt surface finish in 3D printed objects
Its low shrinkage factor and perfect layer adhesion make ApolloX Kevlar a breeze to print with.
We recommend to use ruby nozzles or hardened steel nozzles.
Please be aware that Kevlar reinforced filaments contain a relatively high concentration of aramid fibers, which have an abrasive nature.
In general these aramid fibers will accelerate the nozzle-wear of brass nozzles, much faster than unfilled filaments.

items.text: ASA+AF filament retains all the advantages of classic ASA while offering even greater resistance to wear and mechanical damage . The material has a reduced coefficient of friction, which ensures increased resistance to abrasion (tribological wear). Thanks to its resistance to UV radiation and weather conditions, the material is ideal for outdoor applications, such as automotive parts, drone components, device housings, or components exposed to impacts and fluctuating temperatures. The filament is heat-resistant up to 94°C.
items.at: p. 1: exact product paragraph, source text line 43
items.conditions: Exact-product maker claim; no suitability PASS, design allowable or qualified service lifetime. Concentration, temperature, duration and specimen unstated unless the source specifies them.

items.text: Fiberlogy ASA+AF is an advanced filament designed for demanding technical and industrial applications.
As a result, the material performs perfectly wherever the finished print must withstand intensive use, impacts and long-term operation in outdoor conditions.

Thanks to its resistance to UV radiation and weather conditions, the material is ideal for outdoor applications, such as automotive parts, drone components, device housings, or components exposed to impacts and fluctuating temperatures.
It combines ASA’s resistance to UV radiation, moisture and high temperatures with the exceptional strength of aramid fibers (Kevlar®).
The addition of aramid fibers increases the mechanical strength of prints, improves their durability, and reduces the risk of parts crumbling or cracking under load.
ASA+AF filament retains all the advantages of classic ASA while offering even greater resistance to wear and mechanical damage
The material has a reduced coefficient of friction, which ensures increased resistance to abrasion (tribological wear).
The filament is heat-resistant up to 94°C.
high resistance to impact and mechanical damage
UV and weather resistance
temperature resistance up to 94°C
reduced shrinkage, allowing you to print larger models while maintaining high dimensional stability
reduced material shrinkage
High dimensional stability of prints
The characteristic matte, raw surface finish gives prints a professional look typical of composite materials.
matte, technical surface finish
The filament also features excellent layer adhesion
very good layer adhesion
To achieve optimal print parameters, it is recommended to use a closed thermal chamber and a hardened steel nozzle that is resistant to the abrasion caused by aramid fibers.
it is recommended to use a closed thermal chamber
